correctness.rationale: Completely specified 12-vertex line graph and degree-one predicate; independently equivalent forbidden-56-triple enumeration yields 455 faces and f-vector (12,66,164,177,36). A fixed sequential coordinate matching gives 211 disjoint pairs and precisely one critical vertex plus 32 critical 3-cells. Its entire 1512-incidence directed Hasse graph is acyclic by exhaustive topological sort. Integral discrete Morse theory therefore proves a wedge of 32 3-spheres, not merely field homology. Every one of 48 full automorphisms is explicitly enumerated; oriented-fixed-face Lefschetz traces are constant on each of the 10 classes and S4 character inner products give claimed rational decomposition. Mod-two ranks (11,55,109,36) agree. Rational finite-group invariants yield quotient homology. Verification source and exact replay output embedded.

value.rationale: The cuboctahedron is the canonical 12-vertex line graph of the 3-cube, and its natural forbidden-induced-3-vertex complex is the first higher-independence construction. Its exact integral homotopy type, multiplicity-rich full symmetry character, central inversion split (21,11), and two-dimensional invariant quotient are motivated structural invariants not entailed by an ordinary matching, cut or Čech result. The finding is a complete finite homotopy-and-symmetry classification for a canonical object, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
